defs.def: to wake up; to make sb wake up （使）醒来

ex.s: Emily awoke to a gentle knock on her car window.
ex.t: Emily被轻轻敲打车窗的声音唤醒。

ex.s: I found comfort in keeping myself awake when everyone else had gone to bed, and I loved the silence of the night.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的“安静”标志到处都是。如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母从椅子上的短暂小睡中醒来，手指捋过波浪般的白发，望向窗外蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: On a beautiful Wednesday morning, I awoke in a shared room in the hospital.
ex.t: 一个美丽的周三早晨，我在医院的一间多人病房醒来。

ex.s: I awoke early the next morning,  22  of the uncertain days ahead.
ex.t: 第二天清晨我很早就醒了，22 着前方不确定的日子。

ex.s: We will probably have to force ourselves to waken our curiosity and discontent and keep them awake.
ex.t: 我们可能不得不强迫自己唤醒我们的好奇心和不满，并让它们保持清醒。

ex.s: Robert Frost THE ROAD NOT TAKEN SPRING MORNING Meng Haoran This spring morning in bed I’m lying, Not to awake till birds are crying.
ex.t: 罗伯特·弗罗斯特《未选择的路》／《春晓》孟浩然：这个春天的早晨我躺在床上……

ex.s: They awake at dusk to the sounds of men searching for the meteor.
ex.t: 它们在黄昏醒来，听到人们寻找流星的声音。

ex.s: They're the only people awake when I'm working!" Robert Moore “My work involves repairing the railway tracks, so we have to work at night because they can't stop the trains during the day.
ex.t: "他们是我工作时唯一醒着的人！"罗伯特·穆尔："我的工作涉及维修铁轨，所以我们不得不在夜间工作，因为白天无法停运列车。"

ex.s: During the night, lorries came to collect rubbish and they kept me awake.
ex.t: 夜里，卡车来收垃圾，让我一直醒着。

ex.s: Exercising makes you more awake and ready to handle whatever is ahead of you for the day.
ex.t: 锻炼使你更加清醒，准备好应对当天面临的任何事情。

defs.def: if an emotion awakes or sth awakes an emotion, you start to feel that emotion 唤起；被唤起
